item.title: Accepted Payments
item.description:
At The Firelight Studio, payment is due at the time services are rendered. We offer a wide variety of convenient payment options to make your checkout seamless, transparent, and flexible.

Insurance & HSA / FSA Accounts

While we do not bill insurance directly, medical massage therapy is often reimbursable through Health Savings Accounts (HSA) and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA). Upon request, we can provide detailed itemized Superbill receipts containing all requisite taxonomy codes, diagnosis codes, and provider NPI numbers for you to submit to your insurer or plan administrator for direct reimbursement.

item.title: Appointment Policies
item.description:
I value communication over non-communication, and am willing to be somewhat flexible with clients once they have an established relationship with me. But in general, these are my appointment policies:

Cancellation Policy

If you must cancel an appointment, you have 24 hours before the start time of the appointment to cancel without paying a cancellation fee. If you cancel the appointment less than 24 hours, you will pay the entire session fee from the card on file.

item.title: How to do a Good Massage Prep
item.description:
You’ve booked your first massage, now what?

You’ve been looking forward to your session for a while, and the day is finally here, but what do you do? Let’s talk about it! Here are some useful tips to help you prep for your massage:

Reasons and Goals

This bit of massage prep will help you clarify your thoughts. Why did you book the session? Is it for relaxation, or maybe you have a pain issue you’d like addressed, having trouble sleeping, or something else? How would you like to feel afterwards? Bring those thoughts forward so you are ready to discuss them with your massage therapist.

item.title: Free Massage?
